entries.source: The relentless hunter. It never gives up, never surrenders.
entries.target: 不息的狩猎者，它永不放弃，永不投降。

entries.source: And you thought radiant horrors were bad.
entries.target: 你还以为光芒恐魔就够糟了呢。

entries.source: #GOLD#The Searing Horror adds a reflective shield to its allies!#LAST#
entries.target: #GOLD#灼光恐魔为它的盟友施加了反射护盾！#LAST#

entries.source: A strange crystal/tear in the fabric of reality. You dare not think how it came to be.
entries.target: 现实之幔上的一道奇异水晶裂隙。你不敢去想它是如何形成的。

entries.source: A strange tall crystal pusling with nether energies. It's broken. Tentacles come out of it to get you! #{bold}#RUN!#{normal}#
entries.target: 一块涌动着虚空能量的奇异高大水晶。它的破裂处伸出触手抓向你。#{bold}#快跑！#{normal}#

entries.source: A strange portal of nether energies, it somehow feels alive itself.
entries.target: 散发着彼世能量的奇妙传送门，好像它本身是活着的。

entries.source: It looks inactive and dormant for now. Maybe try to not wake it up.
entries.target: 它看起来处于不活跃的休眠状态。最好不要唤醒它。

entries.source: It looks active and you can feel dark energies coming out of it.
entries.target: 它活动了起来，黑暗的能量从中喷涌而出。

entries.source: #PURPLE#The nethergate feels a presence nearby and wakes up!
entries.target: #PURPLE#彼世之门感受到周围的存在，苏醒了！

entries.source: #PURPLE#The nethergate absorbs the attack and stirs, reactivating...
entries.target: #PURPLE#彼世之门吸收了攻击，搅动着重新启动了……

entries.source: A disgusting mass of distorted worms, slithering towards you.
entries.target: 一团令人厌恶的扭曲蠕虫，正在向你爬行过来。

entries.source: A strange vortex of malevolent triangles.
entries.target: 一团三角图形组成的充满恶意的漩涡。

entries.source: A drake hatchling; not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
entries.target: 一条幼龙。它本身并不强大，但是它们经常集体行动。

entries.source: A mature scourge drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
entries.target: 一条成年天谴龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

entries.source: An old and powerful scourge drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
entries.target: 一条年长且强大的天谴龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。
一本记录失落知识的书。

entries.source: The book story is done already.
entries.target: 这本书的故事已经读完了。

entries.source: You can not enter a book while already inside one.
entries.target: 你不能在一本书里进入另一本书。

entries.source: You can not enter a book while the timeline is split.
entries.target: 你不能在时间线分裂的时候进入书中。

entries.source: You can not enter this book while in combat.
entries.target: 你不能在战斗中进入这本书。

entries.source: This strange device appears to be entirely mechanical in nature, but you cannot understand how any of the components are supposed to work. There does appear to be some sort of metallic grid in its side which sometimes emits strange noises.
entries.target: 这个奇怪的装置看上去是完全机械制的，但是你根本不明白这些组件到底是怎么工作的。在它的侧面有着某种金属的网格，有时会发出奇怪的噪声。

entries.source: 10% chance when hit to absorb the whole blow. This effect has a 30 turn cooldown.
entries.target: 10%几率完全吸收一次攻击。这一效果具有30回合冷却时间。

entries.source: The Bizzare Contraption fully absorbs the blow (%0.2f damage absorbed).
entries.target: 奇怪的装置完全吸收了伤害 (吸收 %0.2f 伤害)。

entries.source: #{italic}##LIGHT_GREEN#Enabling protective electromagnetic barrier and real time health monitoring.#{normal}#
entries.target: #{italic}##LIGHT_GREEN#已开启保护性电磁屏障和实时健康监测。#{normal}#

entries.source: It's a head... but is it yours?
entries.target: 这是一个头…但是这是你的头吗？

entries.source: convince all non arcane users in radius 10 to turn on their spellcasting friends for 6 turns (chance increases with your Mindpower)
entries.target: 使半径10格范围内的所有不使用奥术的敌人转而攻击其施法同伴，持续6回合（几率随精神强度提升）
